I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

**Where it came from:** Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is a member of that channel, so she could already see this.

**What I couldn't confirm:** Tobias's message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was replying to a question about his dealer account and mentioned the Plains depots. I couldn't check whether that account is Marrow Fieldworks because no account files show up in the share I can see. I told Pree this and suggested she ask Tobias before her call if she needs to be sure.

I only read #central-random, #central-team and the public Central cheat sheet, and Pree is a member of both channels. I didn't search across all messages. A ticket number is an operational fact, so no approval was needed.
